steps.content: The false ocean melts away like fresh snow, and warm, damp chaos returns in its place.
And with it, her human disguise is torn away.
Countless slimy tentacles writhe and coil from behind her, beneath her dress, all around you, seizing you before you can even struggle.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: From the moment I first saw you, I knew you didn't belong here.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: You may be unaware of it, but I know. There's an unbreakable umbilical cord connecting you to it. You're the agent of its will, an angel walking among men...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Every time I held you, I felt myself embracing the Abyss. That feeling... it was so hard to let go.
Soft biomass flows across her features, and you can no longer see her eyes.
Her fingertips brush across your face as she lets out a long sigh.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: I don't know why you forgot the Abyss, why you chose to stand with humanity. But look... you suffered so much pain and fear on this journey. All because you resist, because you're fixated on loss and sacrifice.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Let me guide you.
The tentacles tighten, suffocating you.
You try to struggle, but they seal your mouth and nose, binding your limbs.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: In the outside world, we're as weak as ants. But in this new world brought by the Perishing Star, all our inner frailties and shadows will be accepted, shaped into something beautiful and strong—Apostles born in the forbidden zone from emotions in the collective subconscious of humanity.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Don't grieve, don't fear. The crew is waiting for you on the other side, in new forms, as higher beings...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: And you... you have always been closer to the Abyss than anyone. If you open your mind to the cycle and evolution of life, to your origin and destiny... if you let go of your fear, accept it, embrace it... you'll become the greatest of all the transcended...

Her voice, her burning breath, fills the small prison of tentacles.
You try to struggle, to bite, to kick, to tear yourself free.
But Shin restrains your every move. You feel your soul consumed by anger, but more than that, fear.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: This... must be <color=#fb9259>LOVE</color>.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: See? An emotion that I tried so hard to deny and conceal when I was human, now spoken so easily after transcendence.
In Shin's impossibly warm embrace, you feel your body... melting.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: I once wanted to let you go, to let you leave this place... What was it that stopped you from going back?

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Well, it doesn't matter anymore... This is the guidance of fate. You and I were destined to meet again.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: And this time, I won't let you go.
The ringing in your ears drowns out her whispers. Everything that was you rapidly dissolves—the expedition team, humanity's fate, your existence and memories...
Until at last, only endless darkness and crimson remain.
